## PR description
### [Docs] Split diffusion attention and CPU offload guides  [labels: documentation]
## Summary

- split the diffusion attention backend guide into an overview plus focused Dense, TRTLLM, SageAttention, Hugging Face Hub, and RainFusion pages
- split CPU offloading into an overview plus model-level, layerwise, and distributed-layerwise pages
- align Feature Design documentation with the same taxonomy and document the shared selector, registry, offload factory, discovery, and lifecycle contracts
- update navigation, feature matrices, and cross-links while preserving the existing landing-page URLs and legacy section anchors

## Why

The previous attention and CPU-offload pages combined selection guidance, installation, tuning, compatibility, and internal design details in large Markdown files. Splitting by feature family makes the user-facing choices easier to scan and keeps each Feature Design page aligned with the implementation contract it owns.

## Impact

The existing attention-backend and CPU-offload URLs remain valid as overview pages. Existing section links for TRTLLM, RainFusion, SageAttention, Hub kernels, and all three offload strategies remain available through compatibility headings.
